text:
ana: weird regression: downstream ESM edge apps see our SDK overload generics collapse to any after publish. locally types are fine.
pete: can you paste the smallest repro?
ana: (sorry) here's tiny snippet from SDK:
```ts
// src/api.ts
export function fetch<T = { id: string }>(id: string): Promise<T>;
export function fetch(id: string){ return Promise.resolve({ id }); }
```
consumer (ESM + TS5):
```ts
import { fetch } from 'redwood-sdk';
const a = await fetch('x'); // a -> any
```
ci-bot: build note: tsup-dts printed "collapsed overloads to implementation signature" warning in package build.
lia: we've seen this — dts bundlers flatten overloads and lose generic defaults. quick fixes: emit declarations with `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` (outDir dist/types) and run tsup without dts, or maintain a handwritten index.d.ts with overloads.
pkg-bot: created issue #4410: "Avoid dts bundling for SDK to preserve overload inference" assigned to pete.
ana: will try switch to emitDeclarationOnly and add a tiny examples/edge-typing-smoke CI job that runs `tsc --noEmit` against a packed tarball. thanks all.
